edges.notes: Portable engine stacks often combine WebAssembly modules with WebGPU for browser GPU workloads.
Many implementations use Vulkan as a native backend on supported platforms (browser/engine dependent).
WebKit/Safari-class stacks may target Metal on Apple platforms (product-dependent).
Chromium-derived stacks commonly use D3D12/D3D11 backends on Windows (implementation-dependent).
WGSL lowering toolchains (e.g. Tint) commonly target SPIR-V for Vulkan backends (implementation-dependent).
Overlapping browser GPU API space; WebGL is the legacy OpenGL ES-style API (GLSL ES) vs WebGPU/WGSL.
